correctness.rationale: In the common strict-sign chamber the shifted-opinion block is x-(I+L)eta. At an endemic root s the infection derivatives are bs(1-2s)=a and -ks=-h. The upper-root equation gives h-a=s sqrt((b-k)^2-4bd)>0. With a<1 the synchronous trace is negative. Orthogonal modes of a symmetric nonnegative-weight Laplacian give characteristic polynomial z^2+(1+ell-a)z+h-a(1+ell). This proves the claimed strict threshold for 0<a<1, unconditional stability in this graph class for a<=0, and only a zero mode at general equality. At the disease-free state the linearization is triangular, with eigenvalues -d and -1-ell. In the rational two-node case the transverse polynomial at w=1/6 is z(z+5/6) and dz/dw=6/5. Dividing the positive prevalence equations by x_i and taking their sum and difference gives the displayed branch, real and unequal exactly for 1<=t<4/3. Its coordinates are interior and both original opinions are negative; the Schur-complement determinant is -81t x_1 x_2 v^2, so there is a positive real eigenvalue. For a nondegeneracy check, solve the mean equation near u=1/3 for u=1/3-9v^2+O(v^4); then the odd difference equation is v[(9/4)(w-1/6)+81v^2+O((w-1/6)^2+v^4)]=0. This gives a nonzero reduced cubic in the one-dimensional center direction, with the same branch slope v^2/(1/6-w)→1/36. Here 'repelling in the full state space' means unstable to some departures from synchrony, not a repeller in all directions; the synchronous stable directions persist. No mixed-sign or boundary equilibrium classification follows. The frozen check.py was inspected, not run; these are direct analytic and exact rational checks.
